children: Vidar Hasund, Contracted Chief Financial Officer of 2020 Bulkers Ltd., has on November 27, 2026, sold 64 100 shares in 2020 Bulkers Ltd. at an average price of NOK 23,12 per share.
Following the transaction, Vidar Hasund owns 2,110,575 shares in 2020 Bulkers Ltd.
This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to the market abuse regulation article 19 and 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.

title: 2020 Bulkers Ltd. (Euronext Oslo Børs “2020” and Euronext NOTC “2020T”): Mandatory notification of trade
